newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SAirGroup upbeat on Singapore-US open sky.
newsitem.headline: SAirGroup upbeat on Singapore-US open sky.

text.p: SAirGroup said the completion of an open sky and anti-trust agreement between the United States and Singapore should have a positive impact on the partnership between Singapore Airlines and Swissair.
"It opens up the possibility that Singapore Airlines will join the Atlantic Excellence," SAirGroup chief executive Philippe Bruggisser told a news conference.
The Atlantic Excellence partnership, which on February 1 strengthened their cooperation, comprises Swissair, Delta Air Lines, Sabena SA and Austrian Airlines.
Bruggisser said he wants to deepen cooperation with both Delta and Singapore Airlines as well as with the European partners of Sabena and AUA.
